llm-mailroom release `v0.9.2` (tag on the #140 merge). Against the previous pin `65523a2`,
the vendored tree changes only `api/main.py` and `api/README.md`: protected routes serve
requests without a configured token only on a loopback listener and refuse them when they
carry `Forwarded`, `X-Forwarded-For` or `X-Real-IP`. The guard checks the listener address,
not the remote client: a public proxy forwarding to loopback without those headers can
allow tokenless access to protected routes. Operators must configure a token behind any
proxy. Unprotected endpoints such as `/health` and API documentation may remain accessible
without a token on non-loopback hosts. The API reads `MAILROOM_API_TOKEN` per request
(llm-mailroom #171, #172). The tag's `pyproject.toml` still reads `version = "0.9.1"`;
the release is identified by the tag and commit.
